Class OfferTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.model.board.OfferTile
public class OfferTile extends Object
One of the offer tiles on the central board. Each tile has a stable letter identifier, an attached OfferAction describing the draws and reward granted on resolution, and may host one player's totem at a time.

      Builds a new offer tile.
      Parameters:
      id - letter identifying the tile
      occupiedByPlayerId - id of the player initially on the tile, or null
      minPlayers - minimum number of players for which the tile is in play
